`tests/testthat/test-scenario-sparse-spec-witness.R`, committed evidence under

`cs12_precedence.csv`, `cs12_scalars.csv`, `cs12_degenerates.tsv`). TDD
record: RED watched (10 units, nb=107 failed=11 error=8 -- nine units red on
the absent runner or absent witnesses; the plant self-consistency and the
live double-gate units speak MEASURED laws and were green by design; the
self-consistency unit itself caught a dropped law arm before any runner
existed) -> GREEN 10 units / 323 expectations / 0 failures / 0 errors /

(5/5 files, all non-empty, behind the hard five-file count gate).

## 1. Mandate

Pillar 3's twelfth decision-record scenario. The scoping pass selected the
exported engine-spec factory `ms_sparse()` (`R/engines-sparse.R` -- the
S7 property gates plus `msuiter_validate_sparse`: the variant enum, the
four-property finite-nonnegative loop, the l1-positive-mu law, the whole
`max_iter` floor and the whole `[0, 2^31 - 1]` seed window) -- a face that
carries a SHIPPED, acknowledged quirk: the documented default variant cannot
be constructed, because the default `l1` arrives with `mu = 0` and the
validator rejects exactly that, while the in-house benchmark driver
concedes in writing that "the sparse factory's l1 default fails its own
validator; the volume variant is the penalty-free certified default". No
lane had ever rendered the factory's shipped contract -- the accepted
echoes, the abort classes, the fired bullets, the precedence -- as a
decision record. Everything here is closed-form by construction: the plant
is hand-picked scalar rationals, the executed path touches no RNG (measured
at both ends), no network, no data objects, and there is no seed to pin.
The R-bound benchmark runner, the FFI shim and the declined calibration
estimators are DECLINED scope and are never invoked here.

## 2. The plant and the six arms

The plant is scalar call arguments to the EXPORTED factory alone (the
internal validator is never reached; no hand-rolled re-validation exists
anywhere in the lane) -- D3 law: hand-picked scalar rationals only, zero
COSMIC numeric matrices, zero real-data bytes, zero data objects. The six
arms:

- **degenerate-default headline** -- `ms_sparse()` NO-ARGS ABORTS on the
  l1 clause with class `msuiter_error_engine` while
  `ms_sparse(variant = "volume")` is accepted: the documented default
  fails its own validator and the certified default is the variant the
  in-house driver says it is -- both halves observed, committed together.
- **enum and precedence** -- a coined variant is rejected on the committed
  enum clause; and when BOTH the generic nonnegative bullet and the
  l1-positive law are triggered (`l1`, `mu = -1`) the generic bullet
  FIRES, while at `mu = 0` the l1 law fires -- the validator's
  loop-before-law order, witnessed from both sides.
- **penalty ladder** -- each of `lambda`, `mu`, `delta`, `tol` against
  `-1`, `NaN`, `Inf`: 12 rejects, each on its own committed per-property
  bullet; `lambda = 0` accepted.
- **integer ladders** -- `max_iter` at `0` and `0.5` rejected, `1`
  accepted; `seed` at `-1`, `2^31` (`2147483648`), `1.5`, `Inf` rejected
  and `0`, `2^31 - 1` (`2147483647`) accepted -- the window boundaries
  MEASURED, not derived.
- **argument-face gaps** -- the certified variant accepts-and-ECHOES a `mu`
  its kernel-side posture never consults, and the `delta = 0` sentinel is
  accepted and echoed as `0`: committed as observed acceptance round-trips,
  never re-typed claims about the kernel.
- **typed gates** -- a numeric variant and a string penalty are caught by
  the S7 property gate itself, class `simpleError`, and so is a LOGICAL
  `NA` tolerance -- while an `NA_real_` tolerance passes the gate and dies
  one level down on the validator's finite bullet.

## 3. The measured laws this scenario commits

- **The degenerate-default headline.** The no-args construction aborts on
  `"the l1 variant requires mu > 0 (mu = 0 degenerates the exposure
  scale)"`; the volume construction accepts. The two committed halves
  together are the record; the concession already in the benchmark driver
  and the default advertised in the docstring are cited bytes, not our
  claims.
- **Loop-before-law precedence.** The `l1`/`mu = -1` arm fires the GENERIC
  "`mu` must be a single finite number >= 0" bullet and must NOT speak the
  l1 clause; the `l1`/`mu = 0` arm fires the l1 law and must NOT speak the
  generic bullet. Both directions are rails; the ordering cannot silently
  swap.
- **The double-gate NA split.** `tol = NA` (logical) is refused by the S7
  property gate (`simpleError`, `"@tol must be <integer> or <double>, not
  <logical>"`); `tol = NA_real_` passes the gate and is refused by the
  validator (`msuiter_error_engine`, the finite bullet, `got: NA`). The two
  classes are committed as OBSERVED tokens for every one of the 27 reject
  arms -- 24 validator rejects, 3 property-gate rejects.
- **The measured windows.** The object class prints as `"msuiter::MsSparse"`
  (committed byte-for-byte, never re-typed as a bare name); the seed window
  is exactly `0 ... 2147483647` with the first integer past it rejected;
  the property echoes freeze as their fixed `format()` renderings
  (`1e-07`, `2000`, `0.5`, `0.25`).
- **Instrument failures caught fail-closed, again twice.** (i) Before any
  runner existed, the law's own self-consistency unit reddened the census:
  the frozen table had silently dropped the precedence arm
  (`prec-l1-mu-neg`) and the counts refused to agree -- the dropped arm was
  restored from the probe ledger. (ii) The first green run exposed two
  `vapply`-preserves-names versus nameless witness-column comparisons in
  tail expects, fixed with `unname()` before commit. Both are
  OBSERVATION-instrument failures caught by the project's own laws before
  any verdict was committed, never verdict failures.

## 4. Hard rails and postures

The hard rails: the ten accepted arms with byte-exact seven-property
echoes and the observed class label; the 27 rejects with observed class
tokens and verbatim clauses, split 24/3 exactly as measured; the
precedence discriminator in both directions; the RNG purity rail measured
at both ends of the runner's own process; the plant-checksum dual-kernel
identity (the canonical pure-R SHA-256 and the `digest` accelerator agree
on the plant's bytes -- the plant text is the frozen echo table itself, so
the checksum rides over committed bytes, never a float rendering); and the
pre-write witness-finiteness census (no cell empty, NA-bearing,
delimiter-carrying or quote-opening). Postures: DECISION RECORD only -- the
factory's contract behavior on planted truth, no extraction claim, no
benchmark claim, no convergence claim; the D11 float posture honored by
construction -- every committed column is an integer, a label or a fixed
`format()` rendering; the pillar-2 namespace-reach idiom is banned in the
law file and grepped away, as are the declined-family names and the FFI
shim.
